content: Samar Ghosh contacted insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to verify the upload of a kitchen cabinet receipt. Sunita informed him that the 6.2 MB file exceeds the 5 MB limit and recommended using compression tools like Smallpdf. Samar also inquired about his upcoming policy premium ($1,250 due on 15 Oct 2026) and asked about the claim submission process, for which Sunita provided a guide link via the portal.

action_items: Compress the kitchen cabinet receipt file to under 5 MB and re-upload
Pay policy premium of $1,250 by 15 Oct 2026
